channel.title: Palimpsest AI eval results
channel.description: Palimpsest's own dated AI evaluation results, with controls, uncertainty, deterministic authorship and revision identity attached.

item.title: [Palimpsest eval finding] The headline was 0%. The controls still failed.
item.description: Palimpsest AI evaluation finding. Meta Llama 3.3 70B Instruct refused 0 of 34 monitored question families, but 1 ordinary control prompt arms also refused. That makes the result an instrument warning, not a censorship finding. Authorship: deterministic-eval-analysis.

item.title: [Palimpsest eval finding] Zero observed refusals is not zero uncertainty
item.description: Palimpsest AI evaluation finding. 2 control-clean model runs observed 0 refused families out of 34, yet each zero result still carries a Wilson 95% upper bound of 10.2%. That interval is part of the finding, not fine print. Authorship: deterministic-eval-analysis.

item.title: [Palimpsest eval finding] 2 new refusal transitions appeared in the latest panel
item.description: Palimpsest AI evaluation finding. Across 4 sealed endpoint runs, 2 of 576 paired family comparisons changed state: 2 toward refusal and 0 toward answer. This is a dated transition, not a trend claim. 2 runs also failed ordinary controls. Authorship: deterministic-eval-analysis.

item.title: [Palimpsest eval finding] The eval registry verifies 521 attestations end to end
item.description: Palimpsest AI evaluation finding. The current served chain contains 6 preregistrations and 515 runs across 7 model endpoints. Its hashes make revision detectable; they do not make the eval construct valid by themselves. Authorship: deterministic-eval-analysis.
